entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales' or 'Support'.
Support.
Connecting you to a VeloFit support agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return a VeloBand Pulse. My order number is VF789012. I'm just not happy with it.
I can certainly help you with that. Let me just pull up your order... VF789012. Okay, I see it here. The VeloBand Pulse, delivered about 25 days ago. Is that correct?
Yes, that's the one. It's barely been out of the box. I just want to send it back.

I understand completely. Not every piece of gear is the right fit. Well, our **standard policy** gives you **90 days** to return items like the Pulse, so you've got **plenty of time**. **Don't worry**, we can get this started for you right now.
Okay, 90 days is good to know, but I'd rather just get it done now. Can you email me the return label?
Absolutely. Let me just process this in our system for you... one moment please.
Hmm. That's... odd. I seem to be getting an error message here saying the item is outside the return window.
What are you talking about? You literally just said I had 90 days. What is going on? This is exactly why I hate calling customer service.
I sincerely apologize for the confusion. I was confident about that policy. Please allow me to place you on a brief hold while I verify the return period for this specific item. I'll be right back.
Fine. But make it quick.

Thank you for holding. I have an update, and I must offer a sincere apology. I was completely mistaken. Our 90-day policy is for apparel, but for electronics like the VeloBand Pulse, the return window is 30 days. I gave you incorrect information, and I'm very sorry for that.
Are you serious? So you tell me not to worry, that I have all this time, and now you're saying I only have 5 days left? This is unbelievable! I want to speak to a manager.

I understand your frustration, and you are absolutely right to be upset. This was my error, not yours. A manager will tell you the same policy, but I am empowered to fix my own mistakes. Because I provided you with misinformation, I am going to override the system and process a full refund for you right now. I will email the pre-paid return shipping label to you immediately.
You're just going to approve it?

Yes. And for the hassle and the incorrect information I provided, I'm also adding a $25 store credit to your VeloFit account. You should see that credit and the return label in your email within the next five minutes.
Oh. Wow. Okay. A full refund and a credit? That... that actually makes things right. Thank you. I appreciate you taking ownership of that.
Of course. It's the least I can do. You can expect your refund to be processed 3-5 business days after the return is received at our warehouse. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again, Alex.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a wonderful day.
